questions.question: How were the four concentrated binary electrolytes designated while keeping KAc fixed at 20 mol kg⁻¹?

options.A: 1N20K, 2.5N20K, 5N20K, and 7N20K, with the first number giving NaAc molality

questions.rationale: Sample names encode NaAc concentration first and 20 molal KAc second.
questions.evidence_quote: 1 mol kg -1 NaAc with 20 mol kg -1 KAc (1N20K), 2.5 mol kg -1 NaAc with 20 mol kg -1 KAc (2.5N20K)

questions.question: Which 7N20K property combination motivated its selection as the preferred composition?

options.A: A 21.2 mS cm⁻¹ conductivity at 25°C and an ESW up to 3 V under idealized test conditions
options.B: A 52.9 mS cm⁻¹ conductivity and a 1.23 V ESW in ordinary flooded cells
options.C: A 7.3 mS cm⁻¹ conductivity and a 4.2 V ESW in large-area electrodes
options.D: A 0.12 eV conductivity activation energy and a 90% initial charge efficiency

questions.rationale: The authors identify this composition as a compromise between transport and electrochemical stability.
questions.evidence_quote: conductivity of 21.2 mS cm -1 at 25°C and shows a stability window up to 3 V

questions.question: What caveat applies to the reported 3 V stability window?

options.A: It was measured in ideal conditions with a small-area electrocatalytic electrode in a flooded cell
options.B: It was demonstrated in a practical large-format sealed battery
options.C: It applies only to a dry solid-state electrolyte
options.D: It was calculated from conductivity rather than measured electrochemically

questions.rationale: The authors qualify the window as measured under idealized conditions.
questions.evidence_quote: using small surface area and highly electrocatalytic electrode in a flooded cell

questions.question: What threshold current density was used to estimate water decomposition potentials in the LSV tests?
questions.rationale: They set this current-density threshold for determining decomposition potentials.
questions.evidence_quote: a threshold of 0.1 mA cm -2 is taken as a limit on the glassy carbon electrode

questions.question: How did increasing CH3COONa concentration affect the electrochemical stability window?

options.A: The cathodic-side stability improved noticeably, while the anodic-side expansion was less significant
options.B: Only the anodic limit shifted substantially; the cathodic limit was unchanged
options.C: Both cathodic and anodic limits narrowed as water activity rose
options.D: The ESW was independent of NaAc concentration

questions.rationale: The authors report cathodic suppression of hydrogen evolution and a smaller anodic change.
questions.evidence_quote: The noticeable increase in the stability on the cathodic side with increasing salt concentration

questions.question: At 25°C, what infinite-dilution molar conductivity did the Kohlrausch-law fit give for 7N20K?
questions.rationale: The reported Λo parameter at 25°C is 52.90 in these units.
questions.evidence_quote: At 25 C, o has a value of 52.90 ohm -1 cm 2 mol -1 .

questions.question: In the first-cycle comparison of CLTP electrodes, what values were reported for 7N20K versus 1 M NaAc?

options.A: 7N20K: 104/84 mAh g⁻¹ cathodic/anodic, 80% efficiency; 1 M NaAc: 96/36 mAh g⁻¹, 40% efficiency
options.C: 7N20K: 85 mAh g⁻¹ anodic, 96%; 1 M NaAc: 68 mAh g⁻¹, 99%
options.D: Both electrolytes gave 104/84 mAh g⁻¹ and 80%

questions.rationale: The concentrated electrolyte improved first-cycle anodic capacity and charge efficiency over the dilute comparator.
questions.evidence_quote: In particular, the cathodic and anodic capacities are 104 and 84 mAh g -1 , (80% charge efficiency) at the first cycle in 7N20K, while in the diluted solution the values decrease to 96 and 36 mAh g -1 (40% efficiency), respectively.

questions.question: What did the 7N20K/CLTP interface retain after 60 cycles, and at what current did it show 68 mAh g⁻¹ average anodic capacity?

options.A: 90% retention after 60 cycles; 68 mAh g⁻¹ at 1C (136 mA g⁻¹)
options.B: 68% retention after 90 cycles; 68 mAh g⁻¹ at 0.1C
options.C: 90% retention after 60 cycles; 85 mAh g⁻¹ at 1C
options.D: 99% retention after 60 cycles; 104 mAh g⁻¹ at 136 mA g⁻¹

questions.rationale: The paper reports 68 mAh g−1 at 1C and 90% capacity retention after the 60-cycle test.
questions.evidence_quote: when cycled in the WISE electrolyte at 1C (136 mA g -1 ) the CLTP is capable to provide an average anodic specific capacity of 68 mAh g -1 with an average charge efficiency of 99.0%. Finally, at the end of the test (60 cycles), the CLTP/WISE interface shows a capacity retention of 90%.

questions.question: What activation energy did EIS yield for charge transfer at the CLTP/7N20K interface?
questions.rationale: The charge-transfer barrier is 0.12 eV; 0.48 eV is the diffusion activation energy.
questions.evidence_quote: The low activation energy (0.12 eV) proves the very good kinetic properties

questions.question: What diffusion-coefficient scale did the paper report near room temperature, and what activation energy is associated with diffusion?
questions.rationale: The article distinguishes diffusion's 0.48 eV activation energy from the 0.12 eV charge-transfer barrier.
questions.evidence_quote: The value of the diffusion coefficient 'D' at room temperature (around 10 -13 𝑐𝑚 2 𝑠 -1 )
